summary: Are šml and šmly duplicate analyses of the same incense verb?
rationale: Both entries cite the same MEA šmly etymon and the same sense räuchern (in der Kirche), and their participial example ḥa mənne k-owe mšamlono ... is identical, from 94/37. However, šml gives stem II mšamele/mšaməl, whereas šmly gives stem I mšamlele/mšamle. Shared participial evidence alone cannot settle whether the differing finite paradigms are valid variants or an erroneous duplicate; verify them before merging.
